blocks.html: Go to the north-eastern winch (a square hole in the ground with a rope going down it), at a dig site north from Dorian. You will also find Elissa wandering nearby and a training grid near the winch.

options.text: How could I move a large pile of rocks?

blocks.html: Go back to the northeastern winch and climb down, use the key to unlock the chest in the north east room and search it for ammonium nitrate.
blocks.text: Go back to the northeastern winch and climb down, use the key to unlock the chest in the north east room and search it for ammonium nitrate.

blocks.html: Pick up the arcenia root next to the chest.
blocks.text: Pick up the arcenia root next to the chest.

blocks.html: Use a trowel on the closed barrel directly east of the chest.
blocks.text: Use a trowel on the closed barrel directly east of the chest.

blocks.html: Use a vial on the barrel.

blocks.html: If needed, take a charcoal from the sack of charcoal north of the barrel.

blocks.html: Grind the charcoal.
blocks.text: Grind the charcoal.

blocks.html: Mix the nitroglycerine and ammonium nitrate together, add ground charcoal, then finally add the arcenia root.
blocks.text: Mix the nitroglycerine and ammonium nitrate together, add ground charcoal, then finally add the arcenia root.
